chunks: From him, from al-Ḥasan, from Zur‘ah, from Samā‘ah, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: When the mu’adhdhin stands for the salat, speech has become haram, unless it is that the people do not have an Imam known for them.

key_terms.إِمَامٌ: the prayer leader for the congregation
key_terms.الْمُؤَذِّنُ: the one who gives the call related here to commencing the prayer setting
key_terms.لِلصَّلَاةِ: for the salat; indicating the context of ritual prayer

ai.seo_question: Is speaking allowed during the iqamah before congregational salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning speaking during the iqamah for salat. It indicates that speech becomes forbidden once the mu’adhdhin rises for the prayer, except in the case where the people need to identify or appoint an Imam for the congregation.
